title: 第二百三十七章 石蛮怒吼誓相随第二百三十六章 飞升台前别故旧
content_zh:
;;
众生殿的门，还是那扇门。
三丈高，通体漆黑。
门上那些图腾纹路，比一年前更亮了。
九道光，在门上游走。
像九条等待归巢的蛇。
——
楚夜站在门前。
月婵站在他身边。
阿蛮和石蛮站在他们身后。
四个人。
看着那扇门。
看了很久。
——
楚夜转身。
他看着阿蛮。
看着石蛮。
看着月婵。
“进去之后，可能会死。”
阿蛮咧嘴。

那笑容还是那么莽，那么憨。
“老子早就是死过的人了。”
楚夜看着他。
“你不是死过的人。”
“你是活着的人。”
阿蛮愣住。
楚夜继续说。
“活着的人，才有资格进去。”
——
阿蛮沉默。
他看着楚夜。
看着那双空无一物的眼睛。
看着那张还是苍白的脸。
然后他开口。
“那老子就活着进去。”
“活着出来。”
——
content_en:
;;
The door to the Hall of All Living Beings is still the same door.
Three feet high and completely black.
The totem patterns on the door are brighter than a year ago.
Nine rays of light wandered over the door.
Like nine snakes waiting to return to their nest.
——
Chu Ye stood in front of the door.
Yuechan stood beside him.
Ah Man and Shi Man stood behind them.
Four people.
Look at that door.
I watched it for a long time.
——
Chu Ye turned around.
He looked at Aman.
Looking at Shiman.
Look at Yuechan.
"You might die if you go in."
Aman grinned.
That smile is still so reckless and naive.
"I have already died."
Chu Ye looked at him.
"You are not someone who has died."
"You are the living person."
Aman was stunned.
Chu Ye continued.
"Only those who are alive are qualified to enter."
——
Aman was silent.
He looked at Chu Ye.
Look into those empty eyes.
Looking at the still pale face.
Then he spoke.
"Then I'll go in alive."
"Come out alive."
——
